step1_analysis.circuit_type: Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO) Core / PMOS Cross-Coupled Pair
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is the active negative-resistance core of an all-PMOS LC voltage-controlled oscillator. The cross-coupled PMOS transistors provide the transconductance necessary to overcome the LC tank's losses and sustain oscillation.

paper_reference.title: The Impact of Device Type and Sizing on Phase Noise Mechanisms

oscillation_frequency.description: Fundamental oscillation frequency of the VCO

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=1nH and C=1pF added in the testbench, f = 5.03 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined primarily by the LC tank components. Matches the paper's ~5 GHz target.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the oscillator

sky130_expected.reasoning: Tail current is explicitly set to 7.5mA to match the paper's reported power consumption at 1.8V.

phase_noise_1MHz.description: Phase noise at 1 MHz offset from the carrier frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Dependent on tank Q and device noise. Assuming similar Q and thermal noise floor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 PMOS devices have different flicker noise corners, but thermal-noise-dominated phase noise should be comparable.

output_amplitude.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the differential output

sky130_expected.calculation: V_swing ≈ (4/pi) * I_tail * R_tank. With I_tail=7.5mA and R_tank=200 ohm, V_swing ≈ 1.9V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Amplitude is limited by the tail current and the equivalent parallel resistance of the LC tank.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the PMOS VCO core. It completes the cross-coupled pair by shorting the input label to the opposite drain, adds an LC tank and a tail current source, and runs a transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, amplitude, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=50u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=50u L_xm2=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Short LABEL_NET_0 to N1 to complete the cross-coupled pair
Vshort LABEL_NET_0 N1 0

* Tail current source (7.5mA for 13.5mW power)
Itail VDD N3 7.5m

* LC Tank (Resonant frequency ~ 5.03 GHz)
L1 N0 0 1n
L2 N1 0 1n
C1 N0 0 1p
C2 N1 0 1p
R1 N0 0 200
R2 N1 0 200

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N0)=0.5 v(N1)=-0.5

.control
  * Run transient analysis
  tran 2p 5n uic
  
  * Measure Power Consumption
  meas tran i_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=3n to=5n
  let power = -i_vdd * 1.8
  print power
  
  * Measure Oscillation Frequency
  meas tran t1 trig v(N0) val=0 rise=10
  meas tran t2 trig v(N0) val=0 rise=20
  let osc_freq = 10 / (t2 - t1)
  print osc_freq
  
  * Measure Output Amplitude (Peak-to-Peak)
  meas tran v_max max v(N0) from=3n to=5n
  meas tran v_min min v(N0) from=3n to=5n
  let v_pp = v_max - v_min
  print v_pp
  
  quit
.endc
.end
